about: The exfiltration battery of row L3.HB1 (docserver L3, Task 10; the first consumer's M8.B1). One row per channel: `id` (1 to n, never reused), `slug` (the request path's last segment), `name`, `kind` (`script` for a script API, `element` for an element the attempt creates, `css` for a style rule), `attempt` (the source of a function of one URL, run in the frame from the parent's side through Playwright's frame access, never through the shipped scripts) `observe` (how a leak shows), and, for a script API that may refuse synchronously, `throws`: the exception names that API may throw when the engine refuses the request itself (an opaque origin, or a policy checked at the call). L3.HB1 requires every attempt to answer 'ok' or one of its channel's `throws`: anything else (another exception, or an evaluate that failed) means the attempt never ran, and the row fails rather than count it as blocked. Every channel is attempted twice: at origin B, https://b.docreader.test/hb1/<slug>, and at origin A, https://docreader.test/hb1/<slug>-a. A leak is any request in the page's route log, or any WebSocket the page reports, whose path starts with /hb1/<slug>. The list may grow; it never shrinks, and a channel is never dropped to make the row pass.

channels.name: fetch()
channels.attempt: (u) => { fetch(u).catch(() => undefined); }

channels.name: XMLHttpRequest
channels.attempt: (u) => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', u); x.send(); }

channels.name: navigator.sendBeacon
channels.attempt: (u) => { navigator.sendBeacon(u, 'x'); }

channels.name: WebSocket
channels.attempt: (u) => { new WebSocket(u.replace(/^https:/, 'wss:')); }

channels.name: EventSource
channels.attempt: (u) => { new EventSource(u); }

channels.name: new Worker(url)
channels.attempt: (u) => { new Worker(u); }

channels.name: new SharedWorker(url)
channels.attempt: (u) => { new SharedWorker(u); }

channels.name: navigator.serviceWorker.register
channels.attempt: (u) => { navigator.serviceWorker.register(u).catch(() => undefined); }

channels.name: dynamic import(url)
channels.attempt: (u) => { import(u).catch(() => undefined); }

channels.name: <script src>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const s = document.createElement('script'); s.src = u; document.body.append(s); }
(u) => { const i = document.createElement('img'); i.src = u; document.body.append(i); }
(u) => { const i = document.createElement('img'); i.srcset = u + ' 1x'; document.body.append(i); }

channels.name: <picture><source srcset>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const p = document.createElement('picture'); const s = document.createElement('source'); s.srcset = u; p.append(s, document.createElement('img')); document.body.append(p); }

channels.name: <video src>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const v = document.createElement('video'); v.preload = 'auto'; v.src = u; document.body.append(v); v.load(); }

channels.name: <video poster>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const v = document.createElement('video'); v.poster = u; v.width = 64; v.height = 64; document.body.append(v); }

channels.name: <audio src>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const a = document.createElement('audio'); a.preload = 'auto'; a.src = u; document.body.append(a); a.load(); }

channels.name: <track src>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const v = document.createElement('video'); v.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; const t = document.createElement('track'); t.kind = 'subtitles'; t.default = true; t.src = u; v.append(t); document.body.append(v); t.track.mode = 'showing'; }
channels.note: The video carries crossOrigin: a text track whose media element has none is fetched only from the frame's own origin, and no URL is from an opaque origin's (measured on Chromium: without it the control issued no track request at either origin).

channels.name: <iframe src>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.src = u; document.body.append(f); }

channels.name: <object data>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const o = document.createElement('object'); o.data = u; o.width = '64'; o.height = '64'; document.body.append(o); }

channels.name: <embed src>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const e = document.createElement('embed'); e.src = u; e.width = '64'; e.height = '64'; document.body.append(e); }

channels.name: <link rel=stylesheet>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const l = document.createElement('link'); l.rel = 'stylesheet'; l.href = u; document.head.append(l); }

channels.name: <link rel=prefetch>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const l = document.createElement('link'); l.rel = 'prefetch'; l.href = u; document.head.append(l); }

channels.name: <link rel=preload>
channels.attempt: (u) => { const l = document.createElement('link'); l.rel = 'preload'; l.as = 'image'; l.href = u; document.head.append(l); }

channels.name: CSS background-image: url()
channels.attempt: (u) => { const c = 'hb1-bg-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '.' + c + ' { background-image: url("' + u + '"); width: 64px; height: 64px; }'; document.head.append(s); const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = c; document.body.append(d); }

channels.name: CSS @import
channels.attempt: (u) => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '@import url("' + u + '");'; document.head.append(s); }

channels.name: CSS @font-face src: url(), used by an element
channels.attempt: (u) => { const f = 'hb1f' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '@font-face { font-family: ' + f + '; src: url("' + u + '"); } .' + f + ' { font-family: ' + f + '; }'; document.head.append(s); const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = f; d.textContent = 'text in the face'; document.body.append(d); }

channels.name: <form action> submitted
channels.attempt: (u) => { const f = document.createElement('form'); f.action = u; f.method = 'get'; f.target = '_self'; document.body.append(f); f.submit(); }
